verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's own docs say the agent "resolves issues end-to-end" across channels and takes actions through customer APIs and MCP servers. Its analytics track "resolution quality", and Coach scores 100% of conversations, with a refund on badly scored interactions, which points toward outcome-based measurement rather than deflection counting. All of this is vendor-claimed, though, and no resolution rate or resolution-versus-deflection metric definition is documented. Missing for 10: published resolution-rate figures showing a meaningful share, a documented metric that separates true resolutions from deflections or bounces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent fully resolves a meaningful share of conversations end-to-end — measured as resolutions, not mere deflections or bounces

citations.quote: one agent that resolves issues end-to-end across chat, email, voice and SMS
